mandatory_prepublication_checks: Resolve ward and owning block/parcel/public-space authority.
Check full XY polygon, not only center point.
Reject same-Z building overlap; XY overlap needs registered disjoint-Z vertical strata.
Reject unregistered cross-ward overlap and no-build-easement occupation.
Reject physical ROW occupation unless object is ROW-authorized.
Reject water/canal/coast exclusion unless object is explicit water infrastructure.
Utilities require verified service/ROW space and access clearance.
Rooms/fixtures remain inside owning floor/module/building and preserve circulation/portal clearance.
Preserve stable IDs, addresses, household/establishment bindings and interior seeds during repairs.
Update spatial map, lookup, docs, validation and checksums in the same promotion transaction.

enforcement_contract.applies_before: ANY TERRAIN, BUILDING, ROAD, UTILITY, INTERIOR, FIXTURE OR PUBLIC-REALM PLACEMENT
